messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: org=zenithflux high sustained QPS detected (95th = 3.4x baseline) triggering org emergency quota rule. Auto-rate-limit engaged. Root TS: 2323456789
Priya (oncall): saw the page. pulling logs now. is this causing 5xx or just throttles?
Eli (SRE): mostly 429s observed across region-us-east-1, some 503s from overloaded capacity. Siege test looks similar? checking backend latency.
Jordan (runtime): adding detail — model-serving p99 token latency jumped from 180ms -> 600ms around 2323456700. KV cache miss rate up ~18%.
Mateo (eng): zenithflux is on a high-QPS plan but they triggered a weird burst pattern. CS Sam, are they running a big job right now?
Sam (CS): pinged their on-call. They confirm a batch retry loop kicked off after a deployment. They asked if we can temporarily raise org limits to avoid cascading failures on their side.
Priya (oncall): we need to be careful — raising org quota risks noisy neighbor. propose a targeted emergency override for 15m while we patch/retry-suppress on their side. Anyone object?
Eli (SRE): agreed, short window and monitor. plan: bump zenithflux rate ceiling by +2.5x for 15 minutes, add stricter per-route queuing, and enable fallback-model for non-critical routes.
Jordan (runtime): ready to apply. I'll run the admin API patch and route rule change. Posting commands below for audit.
Jordan (runtime): ```bash
# emergency org quota bump (audit: incident/2323456789)
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood.internal/orgs/zenithflux/override" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"scope":"org","quota_multiplier":2.5,"duration_minutes":15,"reason":"incident 2323456789 emergency bump"}'
```
Mateo (eng): I'll preflight watch scripts for mem/cpu and token cost to avoid runaway.
Priya (oncall): Jordan — proceed when ready. add annotation to incident tracker and note rollback time.
Jordan (runtime): applied override at 2323456812. admin response: 200 OK, override_id=ovr_9a3f. Pushing routing tweak now.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: override ovr_9a3f applied by Jordan at 2323456812 (duration=15m).
Eli (SRE): seeing immediate drop in 429s from 18% -> 6% across org routes. p99 latency trending down but still elevated.
Sam (CS): zenithflux reports retries subsiding. they're throttling their internal retries as requested. thanks team.
Mateo (eng): enabled fallback-model on non-critical endpoints (lighter quantized variant). should reduce GPU pressure ~12%.
Priya (oncall): monitoring CPU/GPU and token burn. setting alert to escalate if cost delta > 40% or p99 > 400ms after 5m.
Jordan (runtime): note: we'll auto-revoke override at 2323457712 (15m). I'll schedule a sanity rollback at 10m if metrics look good.
Eli (SRE): create a quick runbook note for postmortem: cause=customer retry loop after deploy, mitigation=temporary quota bump + routing change + fallback model, followups=retry-backoff guidance + org-level testing for zenithflux.
Sam (CS): I'll coordinate post-incident call with the customer and share our suggested retry limits and exponential backoff guidance.
Priya (oncall): handoff: I'm going offline in 25m. Jordan — can you take overnight watch for residual regressions? leave pager routing unchanged.
Jordan (runtime): taking overnight watch. will follow up in #eng-runtime if anything regresses.
ops-bot: :information_source: Override ovr_9a3f scheduled to expire at 2323457712. Auto-revoke enabled.
Eli (SRE): after 5m post-override decay looks stable. starting postmortem doc draft under incidents/2323456789. assigning action items to Mateo and Sam.
Priya (oncall): thanks everyone. leaving a note in the incident tracker: severity=sev2, impact=partial degradation for zenithflux only, customer-facing message drafted by Sam.
Sam (CS): sent customer note: "We've applied a temporary limit increase while you mitigate retries; we'll revoke in 15 minutes and follow up with guidance."
Jordan (runtime): logging final metrics snapshot before rollback: total tokens delta +32%, peak GPU utilization -7% vs pre-rollout after fallback.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: override ovr_9a3f revoked at 2323457712 (auto). final status: mitigated, monitoring open for 30m.
Priya (oncall): closing thread from on-call side, moving to postmortem for root-cause and follow-ups. if anything flares, re-alert. :thumbsup:"
